title: 第21章 十连胜第22章 寒潭名额
slug: 噬神塔第1929章小金的战力
lines: 紫幻的幻术天赋，比剑道天赋都要高。
而且，他居然将幻术与剑术相互融合，形成了一种极其具有威慑力的幻剑。
常常杀人于无形之中。
看到秦易被困在幻境中，小胖干着急没办法，他喊破嗓子，声音也无法穿透幻境。
“死胖子，给我消停点。”有弟子怒斥。
“秦易那家伙得罪了石洛师兄，你还跟他接触，你不想活了吗？”
“等他死了以后，你最好亲自去给石洛师兄磕头道歉，否则外门没有你容身之地。”
面对众人的威胁，小胖倔强说道：“秦师弟不会死。”
众人哄笑。
擂台上，紫幻的身体已经与幻境完全融合。
秦易一动不动，甚至还闭上了眼睛。
体内的先天剑种，疯狂运转，他在感知剑道气息。
幻境他破不开，但是在先天剑种的感知下，任何剑道气息，哪怕再隐匿，都逃不过。
咻！
果然，先天剑种指引秦易，来到了身后的某一侧。
恰好这时，一柄软剑，刺破幻境，狠狠的刺向秦易刚刚所在的位置。
扑哧！
软剑刺空，紫幻也有点发愣。
紫幻皱眉，难道他能看穿自己的幻境吗？
不应该啊，就算外门第一人的石洛，也无法看穿。
很快。
紫幻放弃了这个念头，继续手持软剑，与幻境融合，悄无声息的对秦易展开刺杀。
轰轰轰！
但是，接下来的每一次刺杀，都被秦易躲开。
这是巧合，还是意外？
“该死。”
已经一刻钟时间了，紫幻依旧没能触碰到秦易。
这让他有些着急了。
他可是排名第十的弟子，被一个刚入门的新人弟子耍的团团转，成何体统。
紫幻咬了咬牙，施展出了最强幻剑，手中的软剑猛地抖动，刹那间幻境中出现了成千上万道剑影。
这些剑影，凶猛的刺向秦易。
上万道剑影中，只有一道是真的，其余都是假的。
也就是说，但凡秦易失误找错了，就会败北。
武斗场中。
不知何时，外门第一人石洛也来了。
他身穿一袭白衣，颇有一种侠客的感觉。
但是小胖知道，此人心胸狭窄，在外门称王称霸，任何修行资源，都被他掌握在手中。
只要是他派系的弟子，都能分到足够多的资源。
但其他中立弟子，就没这么好运气了，有些只能分到微乎其微的资源。
甚至，还有一些人，直接被石洛孤立。
“石洛师兄，您怎么来了？”一群舔狗，将石洛围在中间。
content_en:
Zi Huan's talent for illusion is higher than his talent for swordsmanship.
Moreover, he actually integrated illusion and swordsmanship into each other, forming an extremely intimidating phantom sword.
Often killing people invisibly.
Seeing Qin Yi trapped in the illusion, Xiaopang was anxious and had no choice. He shouted until his throat was broken, but his voice could not penetrate the illusion.
"Damn fat man, give me some time to calm down." A disciple angrily yelled.
"That guy Qin Yi offended Senior Brother Shi Luo, and you still have contact with him. Don't you want to live?"
"After he dies, you'd better kowtow to Senior Brother Shi Luo and apologize in person, otherwise there will be no room for you in the outer sect."
Facing the threats from everyone, Xiaopang said stubbornly: "Junior Brother Qin will not die."
Everyone laughed.
On the ring, Zi Huan's body has completely merged with the illusion.
Qin Yi remained motionless and even closed his eyes.
The innate sword seed in his body was running wildly, and he was sensing the breath of the sword.
He couldn't break the illusion, but with the perception of the innate sword species, no sword aura could escape, no matter how hidden it was.
call out!
Sure enough, the innate sword species guided Qin Yi to a certain side behind him.
Just at this time, a soft sword pierced the illusion and stabbed hard at the position where Qin Yi was just now.
Phew!
The soft sword pierced the air, and Zi Huan was also a little dazed.
"Huh?"
Zi Huan frowned, could he see through his illusion?
It shouldn't be. Even Shi Luo, the number one person in the outer sect, couldn't see through it.
soon.
Zi Huan gave up this idea, continued to hold the soft sword, merged with the illusion, and quietly assassinated Qin Yi.
Boom boom boom!
However, every subsequent assassination attempt was avoided by Qin Yi.
Is this a coincidence or an accident?
"Damn it."
It's been a quarter of an hour, and Zi Huan still hasn't been able to touch Qin Yi.
This made him a little anxious.
He was the tenth ranked disciple, how could he be fooled around by a new disciple who had just started?
"Death."
Zi Huan gritted his teeth and displayed the strongest phantom sword. The soft sword in his hand shook violently, and in an instant, thousands of sword shadows appeared in the illusion.
These sword shadows stabbed Qin Yi fiercely.
Among the tens of thousands of sword shadows, only one is real, and the rest are fake.
In other words, whenever Qin Yi makes a mistake, he will lose.
In the martial arts arena.
At some unknown time, Shi Luo, the first person from the outer sect, also arrived.
He was dressed in white and looked like a knight.
But Xiaopang knows that this person is narrow-minded and dominates the outer sect. He has all the resources for cultivation in his hands.
As long as he is a disciple of his faction, he will be allocated enough resources.
But other neutral disciples were not so lucky, and some could only receive minimal resources.
There were even some people who were directly isolated by Shi Luo.
"Senior Brother Shi Luo, why are you here?" A group of licking dogs surrounded Shi Luo.
